about: Branded foods read from the maker's own label page, for scripts/build_foods.py. Values are copied exactly as the label prints them, per the label's serving (or per 100 g where the label gives that). A nutrient the label does not print is null. ingredients and allergen_statement are copied verbatim. allergen_url is where the allergen statement was read when it is not on the product page.

maurten_gel_100.ingredients: Water, glucose, fructose, sodium alginate, gluconic acid, calcium carbonate.
maurten_gel_100.allergen_statement: While Maurten Gels are made using ingredients that are free from gluten and other common allergens, the final product is not certified as gluten-free.

maurten_gel_100_caf_100.ingredients: Water, glucose, fructose, sodium alginate, gluconic acid, calcium carbonate, caffeine. Contains caffeine 100mg/serving.
maurten_gel_100_caf_100.allergen_statement: While Maurten Gels are made using ingredients that are free from gluten and other common allergens, the final product is not certified as gluten-free.

skratch_sport_hydration_lemon_lime.product: Sport Hydration Drink Mix, Lemon + Lime
skratch_sport_hydration_lemon_lime.ingredients: Cane Sugar, Sodium Citrate, Dextrose, Citric Acid, Calcium Citrate, Magnesium Carbonate, Potassium Citrate, Lemon Oil, Lime Oil, Lemon Juice, Lime Juice, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C).
skratch_sport_hydration_lemon_lime.allergen_statement: Dairy-free. Gluten-free. Nut-free. Kosher. Vegan. Non-GMO.

now_carbo_gain_maltodextrin.allergen_statement: Not manufactured with yeast, wheat, gluten, soy, milk, egg, fish, shellfish, tree nut or sesame ingredients. Produced in a GMP facility that processes other ingredients containing these allergens.

now_pea_protein_unflavored.allergen_statement: Not manufactured with wheat, gluten, soy, corn, milk, egg, fish, shellfish, tree nut or sesame ingredients. Produced in a GMP facility that processes other ingredients containing these allergens.

on_gold_standard_whey_drc.product: Gold Standard 100% Whey, Double Rich Chocolate
on_gold_standard_whey_drc.value_notes: The label prints dietary fiber as <1g, so fibre is left null.
on_gold_standard_whey_drc.ingredients: Protein Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Hydrolyzed Whey Protein), Cocoa Powder (Processed with Alkali), Sunflower and/or Soy Lecithin, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Acesulfame Potassium.

silk_chocolate_soymilk.value_notes: The label serving is 240 ml. Like the other drinks in the library, 1 ml is counted as 1 g, so per_100g is per 100 ml.
silk_chocolate_soymilk.ingredients: Soymilk (Water, Soybeans), Cane Sugar, Cocoa (Processed with Alkali), Contains 2% or Less of: Vitamin and Mineral Blend (Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin A Palmitate, Vitamin E Acetate, Vitamin D2, Riboflavin [B2], Vitamin B12, Potassium Iodide), Sea Salt, Gellan Gum, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C To Protect Freshness), Natural Flavor.

de_cecco_gnocchi_di_patate.product: Gnocchi di Patate (500 g, shelf stable)
de_cecco_gnocchi_di_patate.value_notes: The EU label gives salt, not sodium. Sodium is salt divided by 2.5 (EU Regulation 1169/2011, Annex I).
de_cecco_gnocchi_di_patate.ingredients: potato puree 80%[water, dehytrated potato flakes 24%(potatoes 99%,spices)],potato starch, WHEAT flour, rice flour, spices, salt, acidity regulator: lactic acid, preservative: potassium sorbate.
